scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard is finished. I've chosen a handle-free design.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I open it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: By appreciating the uninterrupted surface first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It won't open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the storage is exceptionally secure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls the cupboard finished; A3 and A5 redescribe missing functionality as deliberate design.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's opening question produces A3's surface appreciation; B4's failed opening becomes A5's security claim.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants usable storage, and B4 tests A's claim rather than merely accepting the sales pitch.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4's complete failure of access into an additional supposed benefit.

specificity.evidence: A1's finished, handle-free cupboard establishes a concrete handover that B2 immediately tests.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'uninterrupted surface' and A5's 'exceptionally secure' sustain one concise design defense.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls loose shelves finished; A3 recasts missing supports as an adjustable kit; A5 presents one installed shelf as a finished approval sample.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 identifies missing supports, causing A3's kit defense. B4 supplies a drill and insists on installation, causing A5's limited installation proposal.

relationship.evidence: B4's 'I paid you to install it' establishes a customer with a credible claim and removes A3's self-assembly excuse.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's practical remedy into another incomplete deliverable framed as thoughtful completion, although actual commitment remains small.

specificity.evidence: A1's loose cupboard shelves, B2's missing supports and B4's drill make the disputed job immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'finished sample' economically renews A3's completion defense; the approval language is slightly polished for spontaneous speech.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 exposes absent supports; A3 redescribes the unsupported cupboard as a complete adjustable kit.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 demands paid installation and hands over the drill; A5 offers to fasten one shelf, reframing partial installation as an approval sample.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 consistently describe unfinished work as deliberately useful completion.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 absorbs the customer's remedy into the same behavior: doing a fraction of the installation now becomes a finished sample.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D41 turns incomplete or improvised work into a supposedly thoughtful finished version.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic positive reframing can praise a problem without claiming that unfinished work constitutes completion.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 calls loose shelves finished; A3 labels missing installation a complete adjustable kit; A5 calls one installed shelf a finished approval sample.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the cupboard handover, introducing loose shelves and a customer-supplied drill. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1/A3/A5 explicitly name thoughtful completion; logic 5, B2 causes the kit claim and B4 causes partial installation; relationship 4, B4 invokes paid work and supplies a tool; heightening 4, A5 makes the customer approve a newly reclassified partial deliverable; specificity 5, B2's missing supports identify the concrete fault; wit 4, A5's finished sample follows the demanded installation. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 70 words; hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: The sample proposal postpones rather than greatly increases the consequence, but the causal chain is strong. No rewrite requested or needed for this internal pass.
records.writerReservation: A5 offers only one shelf despite accepting installation; sincere belief in customer approval must carry the completion claim rather than a knowing refusal to work.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D41-single-b's absent report content and executive urgency, this alternative uses a paid physical job and a customer supplying the means to finish it.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The report's complete apart from the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The numbers are the report.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I've finished its supporting structure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's just a title page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A clear vision. Most reports lack one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the finished budget report. Just the title page: I've left room for contributions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the discussion edition. They can supply their figures directly, without reading mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants a recommendation, not a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add 'Approve' beneath the title. Finished decision edition. We've eliminated the discussion entirely.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 declares a numberless report complete; A3 and A5 successively redefine what has been finished.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 makes the numbers essential, prompting A3's 'supporting structure'; B4's title page prompts A5's 'vision'.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 credibly inspect a colleague's inadequate report and remove successive defenses.

heightening.evidence: A5 retreats to calling the title page a vision, but adds little consequence beyond A3's reclassification.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a report handover, and B4 supplies the immediately playable title-page reveal.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'supporting structure' efficiently bridges B2's correction to A5's smaller claim of completion.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 presents a title page as a finished report; A3 and A5 justify missing substance as discussion and decision editions.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's board and figures by proposing board contributions; A5 directly substitutes 'Approve' when B4 demands a recommendation.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a ten-minute board deadline and B4 conveys the chair's requirement, forcing A to change the claimed purpose of the report.

heightening.evidence: After B4 rules out discussion, A5 makes the near-empty report a completed decision instrument and celebrates eliminating discussion altogether.

specificity.evidence: A1's title-only budget report and B2's imminent board meeting establish clear stakes, though A5 leaves what is being approved unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'discussion edition' and A5's 'decision edition' earn their parallelism through B's changing requirements, with mildly slogan-like phrasing.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 demands A's figures for the board; A3 turns the missing figures into an opportunity for the board to contribute its own.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 requires a recommendation instead of discussion; A5 adds 'Approve' and relabels the document a finished decision edition.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's changing edition labels consistently dignify absent work as intentional completion.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from outsourcing the report's content to declaring its decision function complete with a single word.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D41 redescribes incomplete work as an intentionally complete version of a smaller or different achievement.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary excuse-making explains why work is missing; this card claims the remaining work already represents thoughtful completion.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 describes a title page as a finished participatory report; A3 calls absent figures a discussion edition; A5 labels one added recommendation a finished decision edition.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the report handover with a budget meeting and an explicit recommendation requirement. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1/A3/A5 reclassify absent work as deliberate completion; logic 5, B2's board supplies A3's contributors and B4's recommendation causes A5's added word; relationship 4, B2/B4 supply concrete delivery requirements; heightening 4, A5 turns missing analysis into an unsupported approval; specificity 5, A1's title page and B2's ten minutes ground the task; wit 4, A5's decision edition develops A3's discussion edition. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 72 words; hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: 'Approve' lacks an explicit object in a title-only report, slightly weakening practical coherence. The intentional completion rationale remains clear; retain the original.
records.writerReservation: The named editions make A's rationalization conspicuous. The recommendation remains an illustrative proposal, with B free to challenge its lack of evidence.
records.alternativeComparison: D41-single-a bargains through partial physical installation; this alternative changes the institutional purpose of an empty document under deadline pressure.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've used this coffee machine plenty. You press here, naturally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the steam button.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, warming up before the main operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put a cup underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I was checking you remembered the sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 absorbs B2's steam correction while preserving expertise, but A5 claims to test B instead of clearly learning the cup step.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's steam information; A5 acknowledges B4's sequence but does not say what A now does with the cup.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects a mistake and B4 offers practical help, giving A credible opportunities to bluff familiarity.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the expertise defense through 'checking you' without developing the coffee-making task.

specificity.evidence: A1 names the coffee machine, and B2's steam button makes the error immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'warming up' is an economical cover; A5's testing claim is more familiar and less task-specific.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 adopts B2's concealed controls with 'Naturally'; A5 learns B4's dial setting while claiming an established personal procedure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's steam correction determines A3's revised sequence; B4's two-cup warning determines A5's explicit 'Dial to one.'

relationship.evidence: A1 offers B coffee, while B2 and B4 help A operate the machine; A3's cup request sustains the service interaction.

heightening.evidence: A5 advances from knowing controls to claiming guest-specific expertise, but B4 adds another instruction rather than much greater pressure.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes coffee preparation; B2's flap and B4's dial provide immediately playable objects and tasks.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Naturally' and A5's 'Of course' efficiently conceal learning, though A5 explains its expertise claim fairly fully.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: A3 incorporates both steam and the concealed coffee controls introduced by B2.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 identifies the default two-cup output and dial; A5 changes the dial and frames that correction as personalization.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's calm assertions disguise immediate learning from each of B's machine instructions.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 claims personalized mastery after requiring basic operational guidance.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D42 incorporates each newly supplied operating clue while presenting the resulting discovery as familiar procedure.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Bluffing expertise alone can deny errors without learning anything about the task.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The original A3 uses the steam clue, but original A5 mainly asserts authority; revised A5 explicitly uses B4's dial instruction.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised within the coffee setting to make learning explicit. Internal reread scores fidelity/logic/relationship/heightening/specificity/wit 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4's two-cup default causes A5's tailored dial setting. Five spoken turns and the word limit pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. Retain unchanged; the final increase in claimed expertise is modest.
records.writerReservation: The concealed controls and dial are illustrative machine features; the performance still needs understated confidence rather than obvious deception.
records.alternativeComparison: This uses cooperative hospitality and customization; D42-single-b uses shared weather pressure and a more embarrassing assembly mistake.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This tent's familiar. The long pole goes across the top.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the groundsheet rod.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Testing the components.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've never pitched this model.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with such an observant assistant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll have this tent up before the rain. I'm familiar with these sleeves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one has clips. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the clip system. Cross the poles; then we attach the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That fabric's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Step off the inner tent and we'll raise it first. I always lay everything out.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 covers B2's correction with 'Testing'; A5 claims familiarity without learning any further tent operation.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 acknowledges B2 indirectly, while B4 supplies an accusation rather than a practical clue for A5.

relationship.evidence: B2 helps identify a component, but B4 shifts to exposing A and A5 simply demotes B to assistant.

heightening.evidence: A5's 'observant assistant' adds a status joke without advancing the tent task established in A1.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a tent, but B2's unexplained groundsheet rod makes the physical construction harder to picture.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 and A5 are short, but both use generic covers that could fit many unrelated tasks.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 absorbs B2's clips and crossed poles as familiar knowledge; A5 absorbs B4's fabric correction and calls the mistake deliberate preparation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 directly supplies A3's assembly sequence; B4 identifies the inner tent underfoot, causing A5 to step off and raise it first.

relationship.evidence: A1 promises shelter before rain; B2 and B4 contribute practical corrections toward that shared goal rather than merely mocking A.

heightening.evidence: B4 reveals that they are standing on the essential tent component; A5 converts this larger embarrassment into a claimed layout method.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies rain and tent assembly, while B4 gives playable positioning; the exact arrangement of poles and covers needs modest actor inference.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I always lay everything out' earns its defense from B4's underfoot fabric, although A3 repeats much of B2's instruction.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 replaces sleeves with clips and specifies crossed poles; A3 immediately adopts both details.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 identifies the outer cover and the inner tent underfoot; A5 revises the order and reclassifies the layout as intentional.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's confident acknowledgments make newly acquired assembly knowledge sound habitual.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The final correction exposes a larger practical mistake, which A claims as a standard preparatory technique.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D42 makes the character learn the task from fresh clues while treating each adjustment as established know-how.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A status-preserving comeback can sound confident without showing any acquired practical knowledge.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 only labels B an assistant; revised A3 learns the clips and revised A5 changes assembly order from B4's fabric identification.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the whole camping exchange to replace exposure-only dialogue with useful clues. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4 causes A5 to step off and raise the inner tent first. Spoken-turn and length gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. Retain unchanged; the repeated acknowledgment-and-correction rhythm is somewhat visible.
records.writerReservation: The outer/inner confusion is broad physical comedy; a calm delivery is necessary to preserve performed familiarity.
records.alternativeComparison: The tent alternative adds shared urgency and physical embarrassment; the coffee alternative remains a gentler host-and-guest service exchange.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought dinner? I'll wash every dish in your house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only made soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll polish the soup spoons too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please just eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After I repaint the dining room. It needs to match your kindness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 overrepays dinner with all the dishes and A5 offers repainting, though restoring a competitive lead is only implied.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's soup to name spoons, but B4's 'just eat' does not specifically cause A5's dining-room repaint.

relationship.evidence: B2 minimizes the favor and B4 wants A to eat, but neither intervention changes the practical repayment tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 enlarges dishwashing into repainting, but that escalation is not earned by B4's request.

specificity.evidence: A1 and B2 establish a soup delivery; ownership and location become less clear when A5 names the dining room.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'match your kindness' explains the exaggeration, while the repainting itself could follow almost any favor.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 answers soup with a week of dinners; A3 doubles B2's freezer provision; A5 adds a larger freezer to regain the lead.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's already-filled freezer drives A3's reciprocal doubling; B4's tiny freezer and tubs both appear in A5's enlarged repayment.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants an ill friend to rest and B4 asks only for containers; A turns this caring restraint into further competitive generosity.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates from supplying meals to supplying an appliance because B4 makes freezer capacity the obstacle.

specificity.evidence: A1's soup delivery and B2's illness establish the relationship immediately; B4's tubs give the repayment a concrete form.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's bigger freezer follows B4 neatly, but 'That should put me ahead' explicitly explains the competitive motive already visible in A1 and A3.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals greater prior help and A's illness; A3 promises double provision after recovery.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4's small freezer prevents straightforward doubling, so A5 offers a larger freezer and returns the tubs full.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each of A's offers exceeds the favor just described, including turning a minimal repayment request into a major gift.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands competitive meal provision into appliance provision to overcome B's capacity objection.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D43 treats another person's help as an effort to surpass with a larger returning favor.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Excessive gratitude can overrepay kindness without seeking to regain the lead in giving.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 and A5 offer disproportionate favors; revised A5 explicitly seeks to get ahead through a larger gift caused by B4.

records.recommendedEdit: Added illness and freezer details to the existing food-delivery setting. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4's tiny freezer causes A5's appliance offer, making the escalation specific. Hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite required for an internal pass. A5's explicit statement about being ahead weakens the otherwise playable sincerity.
records.writerReservation: The bigger freezer is deliberately extravagant, and the explicit 'ahead' phrase makes the competitive motive unusually overt.
records.alternativeComparison: This escalates material generosity against a caring friend's restraint; D43-single-b escalates personal sacrifice against accumulating workplace favors.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for driving me. I'll cover your whole weekend shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a ten-minute lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll do next weekend too. Such efficient generosity deserves scale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's far too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We're finally ahead of the lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 offer increasingly larger shift favors, and A5 names being ahead, but no new sacrifice follows B4.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 responds to B2's ten-minute duration through 'efficient generosity'; A5 treats B4's excess objection as success.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 credibly resist disproportionate repayment but provide little beyond successive minimization.

heightening.evidence: A5 declares victory over the lift rather than increasing or changing A3's two-weekend commitment.

specificity.evidence: A1's lift and weekend shift establish coworkers exchanging favors, though no scheduling cost becomes concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'efficient generosity deserves scale' states the premise abstractly; A5 largely summarizes it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 repays a lift with a shift, A3 offers a weekend after B2's prior cover, and A5 sacrifices a flight to offer holiday cover.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's additional shift cover drives A3's larger offer; B4's airport sacrifice makes A5 cancel the trip and increase the time repaid.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 reveal a coworker's substantial care; A3's concern about B doing more establishes the competitive imbalance between them.

heightening.evidence: B4's rearranged Sunday causes A5 to cancel the very flight B planned to support, sacrificing A's break to give B a longer one.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes coworkers through Saturday cover; B4 adds the airport and Sunday, though B's holiday first appears in A5.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's cancellation is an earned reversal of B4's airport favor; A3's 'You shouldn't be doing more than me' states the motive directly.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals that B has already covered a shift, so A3 increases the repayment from Saturday to the entire weekend.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals another sacrifice for A's flight; A5 cancels that flight to become available for a still larger sacrifice.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently restores the generosity lead by increasing personal time and inconvenience.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 gives up the benefit around which B's favors were organized, making competitive reciprocity materially costly.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D43 answers each newly revealed sacrifice with a costlier sacrifice intended to recover the giver's lead.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Fair exchange tries to settle a debt; this drive keeps increasing repayment until A has given more.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 doubles the repayment and A5 mentions being ahead; revised A3 expressly rejects B doing more and A5 sacrifices the trip.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised B into an active giver whose additional sacrifices demand new responses. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/5/5/4, total 95; B4's airport sacrifice causes A5 to surrender the trip and cover B's holiday. Hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. B's holiday is newly introduced in A5, but it is a playable offer rather than a continuity contradiction.
records.writerReservation: Canceling the flight is an extreme commitment; its sincerity must remain playable rather than sounding like a sarcastic threat.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D43-single-a's larger gift, this restores A's lead by abandoning A's own travel and offering substantially more labor.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher broke. Let's all eat from one pan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Fewer introductions between courses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll want plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll serve sandwiches. This system keeps improving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A5 invent ways to avoid dishes, but A3's fewer introductions is not a clear routine improvement.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 invokes guests from B2 without explaining the introduction saving; A5's sandwiches do not necessarily answer B4's desire for plates.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects hosting standards and B4 makes the guests' likely needs concrete.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes the menu, but its claimed improvement leaves B4's plate objection partly unresolved.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a broken dishwasher and dinner plan; A3 makes the resulting social arrangement harder to picture.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's introductions line feels imported, whereas A5's 'system keeps improving' states the intended game.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 celebrates a broken dishwasher as plate-free catering; A3 solves bread scarcity and A5 turns leakage into edible bowls and thickener.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's twelve guests and six rolls cause A3's halving; B4's runoff causes A5's hollowing and crumb-thickening plan.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 act as a credible co-host checking portions and mess, materially constraining A's preparation choices.

heightening.evidence: A5 solves B4's leakage problem while finding another saving in the removed bread, increasing the ambition of A1's efficiency claim.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes curry service during appliance failure; B2 supplies exact guest and roll counts, making A3's intervention tangible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's edible bowls and reused crumbs follow the practical problem closely, though its final flour saving adds an extra explanatory beat.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies a two-to-one guest-to-roll shortage, causing A3 to halve the rolls.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 challenges the halved rolls' ability to contain curry; A5 invents cavities and thicker curry.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every obstacle becomes evidence for a newly economical preparation method.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 claims both containment and ingredient savings from the very modification forced by B4.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D44 treats each practical obstacle as evidence that another resource-saving routine can be invented.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Improvising a workaround alone lacks the card's celebratory claim that the inconvenience improves the system.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 links breakdown to shared-pan service; revised A3 saves bread and revised A5 saves both dishes and thickener.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the broken-dishwasher dinner setting and added concrete food constraints. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4's runoff causes A5's hollow bowls and crumb reuse. Hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. The bowl capacity is comic kitchen optimism; actors need not establish that the catering plan actually succeeds.
records.writerReservation: The serving plan is comic household ingenuity rather than a demonstrated recipe; the final line carries several related savings.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D44-single-a's sustained exercise reframing, this uses collaborative troubleshooting and successive concrete inventions.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another guest? Lovely. I'll divide my dinner into an extra portion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you sure there's enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For everyone arriving, certainly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can bring food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No trouble. I've always wanted to know what hosting tastes like without eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't eaten either.

beats.text: Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're opening in twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 broadens a loose leg into inspecting chairs, but A5 personifies the table instead of proposing a broader disruptive repair.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's isolated wobble to invoke a shared maker; A5 names the table after B4 clears the chairs without a practical causal link.

relationship.evidence: B4 supplies a completed test, but A5 does not convert that useful result into an actionable next choice.

heightening.evidence: A5's bad-habits claim adds absurdity without increasing the scale of any proposed solution.

specificity.evidence: A1's loose chair leg and B4's test are playable, although A5 abandons mechanical specificity.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 is an economical rationale, but A5's table joke substitutes personification for the repair game.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 expands one wobbling chair into checking all chairs; A3 expands to flooring and A5 converts opening pressure into closure and counter relocation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 locates the fault in one floorboard, causing A3's flooring project; B4's opening deadline causes A5 to propose closing for renovations.

relationship.evidence: B2 has tested the furniture and B4 protects the opening schedule, making B a practical colleague whose constraints alter A's plans.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts lost opening time and adds counter relocation, increasing both operational consequence and renovation scope.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes café maintenance; B2's single floorboard and B4's twenty-minute deadline provide immediate physical and temporal stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'chairs have exposed a flooring problem' follows B2 precisely; A5's queue improvement extends the same opportunistic project logic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 shifts the diagnosed fault from chair to floorboard, so A3 broadens the project to lifting flooring.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 makes the renovation incompatible with imminent opening; A5 sacrifices opening rather than reducing the project.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A treats each new limitation as justification for expanding the scale of intervention.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 adds business closure and layout change to the original chair repair; it is a proposed tactic, not a prescribed scene ending.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D48 promotes a minor problem into a rationale for solving larger and more disruptive surrounding problems.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Broad inspection alone can be reasonable caution; the card requires using the small issue to justify a growing intervention.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 names no repair; revised A3 proposes lifting the floor and revised A5 closes the café to alter its layout.

records.recommendedEdit: Introduced a café setting to give the broader repair a concrete cost. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/5/5/4, total 95; B4's opening deadline causes A5 to convert repairs into a renovation closure. Hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. The queue problem is newly introduced in A5, though counter relocation follows the established renovation opportunity.
records.writerReservation: The jump from one floorboard to renovation is intentionally excessive; A must sincerely believe the larger closure is useful.
records.alternativeComparison: The café alternative adds commercial time pressure and lost opening; D48-single-a develops domestic disruption through connected fixtures.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shift ends at five. Your dismissal is still pending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's five fifteen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You've demonstrated punctual attendance at the dismissal review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to approve your change of location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 separates shift completion from permission to leave, and A5 subjects going home to A's approval.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 absorbs B2's fifteen-minute overrun into a review; A5 converts B4's departure announcement into another approval requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 asserts the elapsed time and B4 attempts to leave, progressively challenging A's claimed control.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends dismissal control into permission for a change of location after B4 rejects waiting.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an ended work shift and B2 supplies the actual time, though the dismissal review is invented abruptly.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's punctual attendance at an overdue review and A5's location approval maintain one concise bureaucratic voice.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explicitly withholds dismissal; A3 accommodates B's daughter without releasing B; A5 extends departure approval into the taxi.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's waiting daughter causes A3 to bring her inside; B4's completed homework and arriving taxi cause A5 to relocate the dismissal process.

relationship.evidence: B2 has completed the till count and needs to collect a daughter; B4 adds a waiting taxi, progressively strengthening the employee's reason to leave.

heightening.evidence: A5 follows B4's escape route into the taxi and extends A1's shop authority to permission for the vehicle to depart.

specificity.evidence: A1's closed shop and till, B2's daughter and B4's taxi are playable; A3 invents unfinished homework before B4 corrects it.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's permission to sit but not depart neatly preserves A1's controlling logic, though its final sentence carries several instructions.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 cites the daughter waiting outside; A3 proposes bringing her in so B can remain during the cash check.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 eliminates homework as a reason to stay and introduces the taxi; A5 transfers the dismissal process into that taxi while withholding departure approval.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A treats release as a personal authorization that survives completion of work and even leaving the shop.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 accommodates the taxi while extending control to its departure, increasing the reach of the established dismissal game.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D50 keeps B present by making departure depend on permission A claims sole authority to grant.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General bureaucracy routes many activities through procedure; this drive uses procedure specifically to withhold release.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 makes shop closure insufficient for release; A3 brings B's waiting family into the delay; A5 allows boarding a taxi while withholding permission for it to depart.

records.recommendedEdit: Specified the workplace as a closing shop and added a waiting daughter and arriving taxi. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1 requires dismissal and A5 reserves release despite allowing boarding; logic 5, B2's waiting daughter causes A3's invitation and B4's taxi causes A5's mobile dismissal; relationship 4, B2/B4 establish completed work and family transport needs; heightening 4, A5 carries managerial control into paid transport outside the shop; specificity 5, A1's till and B4's taxi give clear locations and tasks; wit 4, A5's permission to sit without departing follows B4's escape opportunity. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 71 words; hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: A3 assumes homework without setup, and A5 relies on expansive managerial entitlement. Both remain intelligible as A's sincere efforts to retain control; retain the original.
records.writerReservation: A3 invents homework as an accommodating use of the wait, which B4 immediately removes. A5 proposes accompanying B without establishing consent or obedience, leaving the authority claim contestable.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved D50-single-b gives a social equal invented authority over a coffee visit. This alternative starts with workplace authority and stretches it into an employee's family transport.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may collect your coat once I've finished with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were only having coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And we're now concluding it formally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll dismiss the café first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes B's coat conditional on permission, but A5 redirects dismissal toward the café instead of clearly keeping B present.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 formalizes B2's coffee encounter; A5 mentions B4's closing café but does not explain how its dismissal retains B.

relationship.evidence: B2 disputes the social authority and B4 supplies an external closing constraint that should change A's tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the object of dismissal absurdly without developing a workable means of delaying B's departure.

specificity.evidence: A1's coat and B2's coffee locate a departure moment, sharpened by B4's café closure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is short but depends on the detached image of dismissing a café rather than the established interpersonal hold.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requires formal release from coffee; A3 makes catching a bus conditional on permission, and A5 retains that authority after the café ejects both.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's bus deadline causes A3's early-departure review; B4's closing café forces A5 to relocate their continued togetherness outside.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a clear time limit and transport need; B4 invokes an external authority that materially removes A's ability to keep B seated inside.

heightening.evidence: A5 complies with the café's demand while insisting B still cannot leave A, expanding personal dismissal authority beyond the original venue.

specificity.evidence: A1's coat and coffee establish imminent departure; B2's ten-minute visit and bus give immediate stakes, and B4 adds closing time.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's distinction between the café's permission and A's is earned by B4, although the final sentence explicitly spells out the authority claim.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's urgent bus departure becomes A3's reason to consider a special early release while keeping B seated.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 makes staying inside impossible; A5 relocates the pair outside while preserving A's claimed control over B's departure.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A treats leaving A's company as a privilege that neither a time limit nor another authority can grant.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 accommodates external closure and uses that solution to continue the same personal detention game.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D50 claims the right to authorize B's departure and preserves that claim when circumstances require a new location.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Wanting more company may ask B to stay; this card treats leaving as a privilege A must approve.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 dismisses the venue; revised A3 makes departure an application and revised A5 keeps B waiting for A's separate permission outside.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the café and coat while adding a bus deadline. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4 causes A5 to relocate the permission wait without releasing B. Hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. A5 proposes waiting together rather than establishing that B actually obeys, leaving the scene open.
records.writerReservation: A's social authority is intentionally unearned; performance must preserve sincere entitlement without implying physical restraint.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D50-single-a's repeated workplace paperwork, this forces A to adapt to a stronger outside authority within a casual social relationship.
